[[Heart of the Forest]] Tier 4 |music = "[[Hypixel SkyBlock OST#Torrhus Canyon|Torrhus Canyon]]" |location = [[Torrhus Canyon]] |x = -610 |y = 43 |z = 244 }} The '''Desert Temple''' is a [[Location]] found on the {{zone|Torrhus Canyon}}. It can be accessed from the bottom of the {{Zone|Torrhus Springs}}, past the {{Zone|Spring Depths}}, and after completing a puzzle. {{ZoneText|The &bAltar &fof an ancient being.}} == Features == ===First Puzzle=== [[File:Desert Temple Entrance Puzzle.png|300px|thumb|The first puzzle, outside the temple]] The '''Desert Temple''' can be entered after completing a puzzle outside of it. It features 12 colored buttons and 5 colors on the bottom. Players must click the buttons in order of which colors appear least often to most often, which is {{Dark Aqua|Cyan}}, {{Yellow|Yellow}}, {{Red|Red}}, {{Color|brown|Brown}}, and {{Gold|Orange}}. ===Second Puzzle=== [[File:Desert Temple.png|300px|thumb|The second puzzle, inside the temple]] After entering the temple, another puzzle must be completed. It features a statue of a bird, a snake, a frog, and a fly. The statues can be rotated by clicking on them. They must be rotated so that: * The bird faces the snake, * The snake faces the frog, * The frog faces the fly, * and the fly faces away from the other statues, towards a wall. ===Temple Altar=== [[File:Desert Temple Altar.png|300px|thumb|The altar room, past the second puzzle]] Upon rotating the statues properly, a door will open, and the player will gain access to the Temple Altar, and permanently gain the passive effects from its {{Pink|Will}}. Players can donate to become a {{Blue|Benefactor}}, making [[Black Holes]] and [[Huntraps]] work {{Green|25%}} faster, and granting {{Stat|Hunting Fortune|2x}} from the {{Pink|Will}} bonus. Upon donating, the player will lose their status as a {{Blue|Benefactor}} of the {{Zone|Forest Temple}} if they were one, however, the time that this donation would have lasted will not be lost and rather added to the time as '''Desert Temple''' {{Blue|Benefactor}}. {|class="wikitable" !
